elements.text: CN-TFD airframe logbook: entries from 1 January 2024 to 26 October 2026 (printed extract)

rows: Annual inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(a) and the scope and detail of 14 CFR Part 43 Appendix D. Replaced right main tire. Replaced all eight spark plugs. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced induction air filter. Adjusted alternator belt tension per maintenance manual. Oil and filter changed.
Shimmy damper worn. Replaced shimmy damper; nose gear torque links checked for free play.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced exhaust gasket at cylinder 3. Replaced left cabin door seal. Replaced left brake linings. Oil and filter changed.

100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Removed corrosion, treated and painted battery box; neutralized battery area. Replaced trim tab actuator rod end bearings; free play within limits. Replaced right main tire. Oil and filter changed.

Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11. Removed switch P/N 83278 at 2,951.3 hours since installation. Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-037.

Replaced rocker cover gasket, cylinder 2. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-031.

100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Oil and filter changed.

Removed engine for overhaul. Engine sent to Souss Engine Overhaul, Agadir. Reinstalled the overhauled engine, same serial number. Engine time since overhaul reset to 0.0. Ground run and leak check satisfactory. Engine logbook updated.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Serviced nose strut with hydraulic fluid and air. Oil and filter changed.

Static system test and altimeter test per 14 CFR 91.411 and Part 43 Appendix E. Transponder test per 14 CFR 91.413 and Part 43 Appendix F. All tests within limits. Next tests due within 24 calendar months.
